description: Fast, dependence-aware resampling and uncertainty for time series and ragged panels: typed block, recursive model-based, and wild methods; streaming and compiled named-statistic reducers; confidence, forecast, and adaptive conformal intervals; diagnostics and method assumptions.
rules: The public entry point is bootstrap(X, *, method=...); typed method specs live in tsbootstrap.methods (IID, MovingBlock, CircularBlock, StationaryBlock, NonOverlappingBlock, TaperedBlock, ResidualBootstrap, SieveAR).
Block length defaults to automatic Politis-White selection via block_length='auto' (avg_block_length='auto' for StationaryBlock).
AR, VAR, and sieve fitting use core NumPy. ARIMA needs the 'models' extra for statsmodels; EnbPI needs the 'uq' extra for scikit-learn.
The measured arch comparison covers four shared methods on compiled named-statistic reduction; the default backend, arbitrary Python callbacks, and materialized samples are separate paths.
The ragged-panel benchmark uses a per-series loop as its time baseline and materialize-then-reduce as its memory baseline.
Call diagnose(X).recommended_methods for a programmatic method recommendation on a series.
forecast_intervals currently supports AR models only.
